items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: I started him off on piano doing call in hell long song.

ctx.x: I'll tell you who I do know of. Who's that? Roosevelt Sax. I know him too. I started him off on piano doing call in hell long song. Is that right? I play a little piano myself, not very much blues, but I'm his background, like some room is my background in the drug band.
